[spoiler=A Blood Debt Repaid][b][u]12:35 pm, Friday, August 1, Wessernian Road[/u][/b]
Tony Messiaon is leaving the hospital after many days of recovering from a broken arm, a shattered leg, a concussion, blood loss, and 2 degree burns to his head and chest. He has been told to try not to engage in anything that could prevent his injuries form healing, thus he should stay inside and try to move as little as possible. Crowds have lined up on the beautiful side walks, and wave banners of appreciation do to the fact that this is his first public appearance, before he had made virtual speeches, but now he's out in his open roofed car. It's a beautiful day with clear skies, and perfect visibility. Then there's a loud [b]BANG![/b] And suddenly Tony Messiaon falls to his knees, then he collapses, blood sprays onto the road, no one can believe what they just saw, Tony Messiaon, beloved head council member, and less a rich politician, and more everyones friendly neighbor that will come over and give you food when you're sick, the Tony Messiaon, was assassinated. People starred in shock as the car turned around, closed its roof and flew down the street, right towards the hospital it had just came from. Then the realization hit them, the shooter could still be around, looking for their target. People started running, parents covered their kids, no one knew if their would be more shots or not. But many people were thinking, what would happen to our glorious nation, and what would happen to Tony Messiaon.

[b][i]Western View Paper[/i][/b]
Today is a day of mourning, as our beloved Tony Messiaon has been killed, shot by a ruthless man who most likely supports Guhui'Bernardio, and Hatzur Zatsugiu, after all the are a known 13,249 people in Guhi'Bernardio, including Hatzur himself. Many of those in Guhui'Bernardio are very capable men, who excel in computer science, guns, bombs or other useful things for a terrorist group to have, in fact it's suspected that their are men in Guhui'bernardio who are in the military but we can not confirm or deny the the rumors. The shooter has been confirmed and caught, the man is named Kiliwo Danf and was once in WVSOU (Western View Special Operations Unit) thus he was a very useful asset to Hatzur Zatsugi, though he may not have been as useful as before, since Hatzur had sent him on a practical suicide mission. Kilwo Danf has been sentenced to the death sentence, specifically by being shot. Though the damage has been done. We have word that a new head council will be elected, most likely Tony Messiaon's brother Mack Mesiaon.[/spoiler]
